term: de re necessity, de dicto necessity and individual versus joint absence
definition: DeRe F present w means some fixed roster member has present at every accessible world; DeDicto F present w means every accessible world has some present member, allowed to vary. IndividualContingency means every member is absent at some accessible world; JointAbsence means some accessible world has no present member. Box and Dia are the existing shared Kripke operators, with no implicit frame assumptions. The actualist de-re variant additionally guards its outer witness by ex x w. Each use of present specifies whether it denotes existence or ConcreteAt; neither is Scott essence-based necessary existence.
note: Theory-relative diagnostic for #435; source-grounded adoption and concreteness defenses remain open. See docs/necessary-individual-quantifiers.md.
